$comment: The clinician use-case tiers (CLAUDE.md §6.1), once. `bun scripts/sync-clinician-tiers.ts` writes ClinicianUseCaseTier into app/ios/NeurOne/Models/ClinicianUseCaseTier.generated.swift and app/android/core/src/main/kotlin/life/neurone/core/models/ClinicianUseCaseTier.generated.kt, and --check fails if either is stale. `label` is the persisted identity: iOS stores it as the Codable raw value and it is written into stored grants, so it must never double as display text and must not change. `rank` orders the tiers for "does this tier reach that one"; it is stated, not derived from position, so inserting or reordering a tier cannot silently re-rank. Price is `priceUsd` per `priceUnit` (PATIENT or STUDY); iOS renders it through the locale keys CLINICIAN_TIER_PRICE_PER_PATIENT and CLINICIAN_TIER_PRICE_PER_STUDY. A tier's UHDR elements are every element in uhdr-elements.json whose minimumTier ranks at or below the tier, less `withheldElements`; a tier with `elementsFromStudy` true has none, because they are IRB-defined per study descriptor (§6.3). `withheldElements` (none today) names elements a tier's set leaves out although their minimumTier would admit them; the tier contents as a whole are under review in OI-CONSENT-08. Name-derived locale key: CLINICIAN_TIER_<NAME>.
